messages:
lara: Rolling out 'Local Audit Export' for Private/VPC customers next week. Purpose: provide a signed, redacted audit bundle from the on-prem agent for compliance/legal reviews. Canary Tue -> broad Wed. Opt-in only.

lara: Quick bullets: requires agent v3.2+, customer admin consent + signed DPA addendum, exports encrypted and signed, default redaction profiles (pci, pii, admin_logs). Limits: 1 concurrent export per tenant, 40GB max per bundle (we'll support chunking), 4 exports/hour rate limit.

mike: Ops note: adding an export-queue metric and a per-tenant backlog alert. Also adding a temporary emergency-throttle feature in the console to pause exports for a tenant.

saira: Security: please ensure the signing key rotation flow is covered. We will HSM-wrap signing keys; infra needs to publish the verification public key for customers to validate signatures.

lara: Customer API example:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://private-console.redwood.example/api/v1/tenants/ACME/export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","profile":"pci","include_telemetry":false}'
```

nina: Legal: draft addendum uploaded to /legal/drafts/local-audit-addendum.md. Do not share externally. Need CS flow for checkbox + record of admin identity.

infra-bot: deploy-schedule: canary exports enabled 2026-04-14T09:00Z - 2026-04-14T11:00Z. Auto-rollback at threshold failure.

ben: CS: I can host two office hours for customers Thursday/Friday for handoffs. Will need a runbook and demo tenant.

ryan: Question on SLAs: will we guarantee delivery time? Any perf impact on Dedicated inference nodes?

lara: @ryan no change to inference SLOs. Exports are background best-effort jobs. We'll publish expected windows: <=24h for <5GB, <=72h for larger. For Dedicated tenants we recommend running exports on separate control-plane resources; note this in the customer doc.

mike: Action items: infra to add KMS policy change, ops to update runbook with how to abort stuck exports, cs to prepare consent flow, legal to finalize addendum. Please ack in-thread when done.

saira: Ack. I'll schedule key-rotation review.

ben: Ack. Demo tenant requested -> lara, pls add.

lara: Thanks. If you need early access or want to rehearse customer calls DM me. :rocket:
